text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the middle of watching some
Umamusume
train when Hishi Amazon
calls out to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! Have you seen Sky?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh... She's gone AWOL in the middle
of her
extra classes again.
choice_data_list: No, I haven't seen it, but...
No, I didn't see it, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
As the leader of Miho Dorm, I figured I
should
scold her good and set her
straight.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there she is! Now I just gotta figure
out how
to nab her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Hishi Amazon that it would be
more
effective to approach her from the
sides rather
than going after her
head-on.
choice_data_list: Let's catch them in a pincer movement.
Let's guide them to the track

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'll get some of my
residents to help
me catch that slippery
little sucker!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Raaaaah! There's no slackin' off on
Hishiama's
watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky appears to have anticipated
the trap,
but she admits defeat after
getting boxed in by a
multi-layered wall
of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this served as not only a
good
punishment for Seiun Sky, but an
effective
training activity in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest luring Seiun Sky to the track so
that
chasing her eventually ends up as a
form of
training through partner running.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, so I don't necessarily have to catch
her, huh?
All right, I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them play cat-and-mouse for
a while,
until Seiun Sky realizes to her
horror that she's
been totally duped.
